f3e1b8bd:  ;;
 ;This routine accumulates and prints totals for transcription productivity
 ;by service/specialty or physician.
 ;;
 ;Input :
 ; DGJTL       = Totalling mode, 'PHY' for physician or 'SER' for service/specialty
 ; DGJTOT(d)   = ^TMP global containing records for division d
 ; DGJTDIR     = Direction of sort, 1=alphabetical, 2=practitioner sequence
 ; DGJTDAT     = Date for this report in FileMan format
 ; DGU         = User ^ flag to quit
 ;;
 ;Output:
 ; Prints totals by service/specialty or physician and division totals
 ; for physician, division, DIC-D/C, DIC-TRANSCRIPTION, TRANS-CODING
 ; and >30 days delinquent records.
 ;;
 ;Temporary variables used:
 ; DGJCNTX     = Count variables
 ; DGJDOC      = Physician or service/specialty name
 ; DGJJX       = Temp variable
 ; DGJPHTOT(d,n)   = ^TMP($J,"PHTOT",d,n), physician totals
 ; DGJSPTOT(d,n,sn) = ^TMP($J,"SPTOT",d,n,sn), service/specialty totals
 ; DGJSVTOT(d,n)   = ^TMP($J,"SVTOT",d,n), service totals
 ; DGJTCOD     = Total TRANS-CODING value
 ; DGJTDIC     = Total DIC-D/C value
 ; DGJTO30     = Total >30 days delinquent
 ; DGJTOREC    = Total number of records
 ; DGJTRN      = Total DIC-TRANS value
 ; DGJTTI      = Loop control
 ; DGJTTODY    = Total TOT DAYS value
 ; DGJTTRN     = Total DIC-TRANS value
